title: The Rubber Band Ball
subtitle: I don’t want to be her again
label: New essay
alt_text: A faded childhood photo of a little girl with blonde hair and bangs in a white feathered halo and angel wings, looking at the camera unsmiling, shown as a bordered print on lavender above the title The Rubber Band Ball. Not Plain.

captions.facebook:
“I’ve always been afraid to write my story.”

The questions come first. What people will think. Whether they'll be upset that I'm writing about them. Whether my mom will find it.

But those aren't what scare me. What scares me is what writing might bring up, everything I've packed down like a rubber band ball, each band choking the one beneath it.

This one is heavy. Please read with care.

New essay on Not Plain. Read it here:
https://sarahnotplain.substack.com/p/the-rubber-band-ball
